rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), New Delhi

Cluster randomized controlled trial comparing Holistic lifestyle Education along with physical and cognitive Training to the existing rural Indian lifestyle for improving cognition and preventing dementia in cognitively Normal high-risk rural older Adults: a SMRUTHI INDIA initiative
3 years (project duration printed as up to October 2026)
Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) – Dietitian; Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) – Statistician; Project Technical Support-I
Upper age limit as per ICMR norms
Online form (QR code) and CV by email – both mandatory

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: The posts are in a research project at the Department of Neurology, Neuro Science Centre, AIIMS, New Delhi, led by Dr. Anu Gupta, Associate Professor, Department of Neurology. The project, funded by the Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR), is a cluster randomized controlled trial that compares holistic lifestyle education with physical and cognitive training against the existing rural Indian lifestyle, to improve cognition and prevent dementia in cognitively normal, high-risk rural older adults. It is part of the SMRUTHI INDIA initiative.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: AIIMS New Delhi has advertised 3 posts in total under Project Code I-2038. The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of these posts.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates need either of these: 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) + two years of experience in the relevant subject/field, OR Three-year graduate degree in the relevant subject/field + one year of experience in the relevant subject. The upper age limit for all three posts is as per ICMR norms; the notice prints no figure and no cut-off date. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates will be given as per ICMR rules. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

Scan the QR code given in the notice and complete the online application form (the notice also prints the Google Form link under the QR code). faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS New Delhi Recruitment 2026 for Project Code I-2038?
faq.answer: There are 3 posts: one Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) – Dietitian, one Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) – Statistician and one Project Technical Support-I.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online form must be completed and the CV emailed on or before 18 November 2026, by 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the Dietitian post?
faq.answer: A first-class postgraduate degree in Nutrition, Dietetics, Food and Nutrition, Clinical Nutrition, or a related subject from a recognized university; relevant experience in Neurology will be preferred.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the Statistician post?
faq.answer: A first-class postgraduate degree in Statistics, Biostatistics, Applied Statistics, or a related subject from a recognized university; experience in statistical analysis of clinical or neurological research data will be preferred.

faq.question: Q5. Who can apply for Project Technical Support-I?
faq.answer: Candidates with 10th + Diploma (MLT/DMLT/ITI or equivalent) and two years of experience in the relevant field, or a three-year graduate degree in the relevant field with one year of experience; good knowledge of computer is desirable.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for all posts is as per ICMR norms, with age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PwBD candidates as per ICMR rules.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Complete the online application form through the QR code in the notice and send your updated CV to [email protected] by 10:00 AM on 18 November 2026; both steps are mandatory.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Only short-listed candidates will be called for an interview.

faq.question: Q9. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA will be provided for appearing in the interview.

faq.question: Q10. What is the tenure of these posts?
faq.answer: The notice gives a tenure of 3 years for each post, in a project funded by ICMR.
